# Pulse Personal 0.8.0

Version 0.8.0 is published under the npm `preview` tag. It is not the stable
default or production ready. The owner-machine migration passed on 2026-08-09, and
its old sources are preserved in a verified encrypted external archive. On
2026-08-12, installed local epoch 34 passed automatic semantic recall and
one-call writes across fresh Codex and Claude Code sessions. A cancelled search
did not disable full semantic retrieval for the next question. Personal memory
crossed projects, project memory did not, an unrelated question received no
memory, and both hosts remained usable with Pulse stopped. The one-day
owner-machine dogfood is now running in those two hosts. One broad, ambiguous
Claude question still surfaced an unrelated old memory, so this remains a
dogfood candidate rather than a release claim. Cursor live acceptance remains
pending. The stable published install remains 0.7.2.

A separate Claude Chat remote-connector experiment passed on 2026-08-11 with
an isolated hosted store of 21 memories. It required an account-level
Instructions for Claude rule plus Pulse set to Always available. MCP server
instructions alone were insufficient. Each ordinary message makes one visible
pulse_recall call; this is neither local Personal synchronization nor a
published installation path.

Pulse is memory for AI tools: it gives Codex and Claude Code the knowledge they
need when they need it and stays silent when nothing relevant is found. The
public package `@zbs-gg/pulse` contains only Personal: no shared-memory server,
cloud synchronization, team command, device key, or shared database is shipped.

Version 0.7.2 is the stable public release for Macs with Apple Silicon. Version
0.8.0 is a public preview for the same target. The exact 0.8.0 archive passed a
clean Apple Silicon installation before publication. The npm `latest` tag
resolves to 0.7.2 and `preview` resolves to 0.8.0. Other operating systems are
not public support claims yet.

Before installation, inspect README.md, AGENTS.md, and
docs/SECURITY_INSTALL_CHECKLIST.md. Explain what will be written and ask for
confirmation.

Normal installation:

    npx -y @zbs-gg/pulse@0.7.2 init codex
    pulse doctor
    pulse home

Preview installation:

    npx -y @zbs-gg/pulse@preview init codex

Per-harness preview and confirmation:

    pulse init codex --dry-run
    pulse init claude-code --dry-run
    pulse init cursor --dry-run
    pulse init <harness> --yes
    pulse init <harness> --only <harness>

Trust boundaries:

- memory stays in the local Pulse data directory;
- raw transcript capture and old-chat import are off by default;
- transcript-, secret-, and path-like capsules are rejected;
- no backend model call is enabled by default;
- failure of optional memory must not block terminal, files, Stop/Cancel,
  goal controls, or session completion, and must not create an automatic
  continuation;
- disconnect preserves data; whole-vault wipe requires a separate explicit
  confirmation.
- emotional memory describes one moment, never a personality trait;
- emotional influence halves every 24 hours and stops shaping current context
  after seven days, while the event remains in history;
- raw user quotes and full conversations are not stored with emotional marks;
- one unanswered cause question may appear only in a later ordinary response
  and never creates an automatic continuation.

0.8 preview host contract:

- expose only `pulse_memory`; keep `pulse_remember` and `pulse_graph_delta` as
  hidden compatibility aliases;
- write at most three compact durable items during the ordinary working turn;
- do not run a separate finalizing model turn or block Stop;
- retrieve temporarily on each user question, save neither the question nor a
  session-start context package, and offer at most four memories / 600 tokens;
- omit memory context when relevance is weak.
- let `pulse storage` report protected and removable data; let `pulse storage
  clean` remove only unchanged generated artifacts while preserving the active
  release, one rollback, the vault, keys, sources, and unknown files.

Official 0.6.7 Personal databases upgrade in place. Databases from unpublished
shared-memory builds are refused without modification.

To merge fragmented local stores without altering them, first run
`pulse migrate local-stores --out local-memory-preview.json --open`. Only real
contradictions need a human choice; commit uses the exact confirmation printed
by Pulse.

The local MCP server uses stdio, supports protocol `2026-07-28` and older
clients, and keeps persistent data in SQLite independently of the connection.

Pulse Team is a separate private pilot. It is not present in this repository
or the npm package. Do not infer that the presence of 0.8 code proves a real
three-person pilot, fresh-session acceptance, or a published emotional-memory
feature.

Status: Personal 0.8.0 is published as an npm preview; installed local epoch 34 passed
migration, cancellation-safe semantic search, fresh Codex/Claude Code automatic
recall, cross-host writes, project isolation, irrelevant-query silence, and
fail-open operation; one-day owner-machine dogfood started in those two hosts
on 2026-08-12; broad ambiguous questions remain under observation and Cursor
acceptance is pending; separate Claude Chat remote recall passed with a visible
per-message tool call and no Personal sync; not the stable default or production ready.
